title: Chloroform-free DNA Extraction - Ammonium Acetate Precipitation Method
author: NEOF - NERC Environmental Omics Facility VF
materials: Add 250 µL Digsol buffer (see Materials for recipe) and 10 µL Proteinase K, 2mL Qiagen Catalog #19131 to a lablelled 1.5ml tube.

Tissue: Cut into small pieces (<1cm 2 ) with a sterile razor blade on a sterile glass plate before adding to the 1.5mL tube. Blood in ethanol: Centrifuge blood sample at 13,000rpm for about 1 min (to pellet sample). Remove sample from ethanol with toothpick and blot onto tissue. When almost dry, transfer the toothpick into the 1.5mL tube and jiggle to dislodge the blood. Remove toothpick and place in disinfectant. Swab in ethanol: Dry of ethanol and place into the 1.5mL tube. Snap off the end of the swap so the lid may close. Feather: Cut the calamus of 1-3 feathers into small pieces with a sterile razor blade on a sterile glass plate before adding to the tube. If feathers are very small and blood spots are present on the tips, feathers can be added whole. Hair: Place hair(s) into the 1.5mL tube preferably with the largest root and add 5 µL 1M DTT Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #43816 Insect: Degut and add to 1.5mL tube. If the insect is very small, starve for 48hrs before freezing. Add 5 µL 1M DTT Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Catalog #43816 . Crush with a pestle or add a metal lysing bead and place on TissueLyser (Qiagen) for 2min, 30/s.
Once fully dry add approx. 100 µL Low TE (see Materials for recipe). Add less if a very tiny pellet or no pellet is observed. Flick sample to dislodge pellet.

steps.title: Digest samples at 55 °C
steps.instruction: Vortex the samples, then place them in a rotating oven at 55 °C for 3 hours (or overnight) for maximum digestion.

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 300 µL of 4 M ammonium acetate (Merck MilliporeSigma, catalog #A1542-500G) to each sample.

steps.title: Vortex at room temperature
steps.instruction: Vortex the mixture several times over a period of at least 15 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant
steps.instruction: Aspirate the clear supernatant (containing DNA) into a new labelled 1.5 mL tube and discard the tube with the pelleted protein debris.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 100 % ethanol and invert the tube gently several times to precipitate the DNA.

steps.title: Remove ethanol (first wash)
steps.instruction: Pour off the ethanol in a smooth motion, taking care not to lose the DNA pellet.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70 % ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of 70 % ethanol and invert gently several times to clean the pellet.

steps.title: Remove ethanol and dry pellet
steps.instruction: Pour off the ethanol smoothly (or use a pipette), then stand the tubes upside‑down on clean tissue until dry (≈30–60 minutes). Drying can be accelerated with heat from a lamp.

substeps.instruction: Dry pellet upside‑down on tissue for 30–60 min (optional lamp heating)

steps.title: Dissolve pellet in Low TE
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a thermomixer or shaking oven at 50 °C for 30 minutes to dissolve the pellet; if the pellet has not completely dissolved, add more Low TE buffer.

steps.title: Store DNA solution
steps.instruction: Store the dissolved DNA at –20 °C for long‑term storage or at 4 °C for short‑term storage.
